# appdynamics_health_rule (Resource)

An AppDynamics health rule, defining warning/critical evaluation criteria for an entity in a business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appdynamics_health_rule" "high_cpu" {
  application_id                = 42
  name                          = "High CPU Usage"
  enabled                       = true
  schedule_name                 = appdynamics_schedule.business_hours.name
  use_data_from_last_n_minutes  = 15
  wait_time_after_violation     = 5

  affects_json = jsonencode({
    affectedEntityType = "TIER_NODE_HARDWARE"
    affectedEntities = {
      tierOrNode = "TIER_AFFECTED_ENTITIES"
      affectedTiers = {
        affectedTierScope = "SPECIFIC_TIERS"
        tiers             = ["Tier1"]
        shouldNot         = false
      }
    }
  })

  eval_criterias_json = jsonencode({
    criticalCriteria = {
      conditionAggregationType = "ALL"
      conditions = [
        {
          name      = "A"
          shortName = "A"
          evalDetail = {
            evalDetailType         = "SINGLE_METRIC"
            metricPath              = "Hardware Resources|CPU|%Busy"
            metricAggregateFunction = "VALUE"
            metricEvalDetail = {
              metricEvalDetailType = "SPECIFIC_TYPE"
              compareCondition      = "GREATER_THAN_SPECIFIC_VALUE"
              compareValue           = 90
            }
          }
        }
      ]
      evalMatchingCriteria = {
        matchType = "AVERAGE"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `affects_json` (String) JSON object for the Affects block, e.g. {"affectedEntityType":"TIER_NODE_HARDWARE","affectedEntities":{"tierOrNode":"TIER_AFFECTED_ENTITIES","affectedTiers":{"affectedTierScope":"SPECIFIC_TIERS","tiers":["Tier1"],"shouldNot":false}}}. See the Splunk AppDynamics Health Rule API docs for the shape per affectedEntityType.
- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this health rule belongs to.
- `eval_criterias_json` (String) JSON object for the EvalCriterias block (criticalCriteria / warningCriteria). See the Splunk AppDynamics Health Rule API docs for the shape.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `schedule_name` (String)
- `use_data_from_last_n_minutes` (Number) Evaluation window in minutes (1-360, or multiples of 10).
- `wait_time_after_violation` (Number) Minutes to wait after a violation before re-evaluating.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<application_id>/<health_rule_id>"
terraform import appdynamics_health_rule.high_cpu 42/205
```
